description: This file contains functions and logic related to handling HTTP response headers, processing backend responses, managing response buffers, handling various HTTP headers, dealing with caching and conditional requests, and supporting X-Sendfile and related features within the lighttpd web server codebase.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ int http_response_buffer_append_authority(request_st * const r,buffer * const o)
methods.description: Appends the authority part of the URI or derives it from the socket if blank, handling loopback and hostname logic.

methods.name: int http_response_redirect_to_directory(request_st * const r,int status)
methods.description: Handles HTTP redirects to directory URLs with the proper scheme and authority, setting Location or Content-Location headers.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void http_response_delay(connection * const con)
methods.description: Implements response delay feature based on configuration, delaying invalid credentials responses.

methods.name: int http_response_omit_header(request_st * const r,const data_string * const ds)
methods.description: Determines whether certain headers (like X-Sendfile, X-LIGHTTPD) should be omitted to prevent conflicts.

methods.name: strflife_cache_reset
methods.description: Resets the internal cache used for formatting the Last-Modified and Date headers.

methods.name: const buffer * strftime_cache_get(const unix_time64_t last_mod)
methods.description: Returns a cached string representation of last modification time or generates it if not cached.

methods.name: const buffer * http_response_set_last_modified(request_st * const r,const unix_time64_t lmtime)
methods.description: Sets the Last-Modified header in the response, possibly using cache.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ int http_response_maybe_cachable(const request_st * const r)
methods.description: Checks if the current request is cacheable based on request headers.

methods.name: int http_response_handle_cachable(request_st * const r,const buffer * lmod,const unix_time64_t lmtime)
methods.description: Handles conditional GET requests based on ETag and Last-Modified headers, returning 304 if cache is valid.

methods.name: void http_response_body_clear(request_st * const r,int preserve_length)
methods.description: Resets the response body state/caching headers, optionally preserving Content-Length.

methods.name: void http_response_header_clear(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Clears the internal response header state, preparing for new headers.

methods.name: void http_response_reset(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Resets entire response state to prepare for a new request or error handling.

methods.name: handler_t http_response_reqbody_read_error(request_st * const r,int http_status)
methods.description: Handles errors reading request body, setting error status and resetting response body state.

methods.name: void http_response_send_file(request_st * const r,const buffer * const path,stat_cache_entry * sce)
methods.description: Serves a static file as HTTP response, handling conditional headers, MIME type, and caching.

methods.name: int http_response_xsendfile_path_check(const request_st * const r,buffer * const path,const array * const xdocroot)
methods.description: Checks if the X-Sendfile path is valid and under the configured document root.

methods.name: void http_response_xsendfile(request_st * const r,buffer * const path,const array * const xdocroot)
methods.description: Serves a file via X-Sendfile, after validating the path.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void http_response_xsendfile2(request_st * const r,const buffer * const value,const array * const xdocroot)
methods.description: Handles X-Sendfile2 responses, supporting ranges and multiple files.

methods.name: int http_response_xsendfilex(request_st * const r,http_response_opts * const opts)
methods.description: Determines which X-Sendfile variant to invoke based on headers and backend type.

methods.name: void http_response_backend_error(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Handles response errors from backend, terminating the response if needed.

methods.name: void http_response_backend_done(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Finalizes the response after backend processing, ensuring proper cleanup and error states.

methods.name: void http_response_upgrade_read_body_unknown(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Prepares a connection to upgrade protocol to transparent proxy.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ int http_response_append_buffer_simple_accum(const request_st * const r,const off_t len)
methods.description: Checks if small buffer can be accumulated before flushing to a tempfile.

methods.name: int http_response_append_buffer(request_st * const r,buffer * const mem,const int simple_accum)
methods.description: Appends buffer data to the response, decoding chunks if needed.

methods.name: int http_response_append_splice(request_st * const r,http_response_opts * const opts,buffer * const b,const int fd,unsigned int toread)
methods.description: Uses splice() for efficient data transfer if supported.

methods.name: int http_response_append_mem(request_st * const r,const char * const mem,uint32_t len)
methods.description: Appends raw memory to response buffer, decoding chunks if necessary.

methods.name: int http_response_transfer_cqlen(request_st * const r,chunkqueue * const cq,size_t len)
methods.description: Transfers data from chunkqueue to response, used for protocols like FastCGI.

methods.name: int http_response_process_headers(request_st * const restrict r,http_response_opts * const restrict opts,char * const restrict s,const unsigned short hoff[8192],const int is_nph)
methods.description: Parses and processes response headers received from backend, handling various header types and status.

methods.name: handler_t http_response_read(request_st * const r,http_response_opts * const opts,buffer * const b,fdnode * const fdn)
methods.description: Main routine for reading and handling incoming response data, parsing headers, and managing response state.
